name: Lurcher
location: Beldama Wyrd Tree, Boulderfall Pass, Near Brackenleaf, Driladan Pass, Dread Vullain, Greenshade, Hei-Halai, Jackdaw Cove, Percolating Mire, Reticulated Spine, Rootwater Grove, Shademist Moors, Shor's Stone Mine, Three Tribes Camp, Vale of the Guardians, Venomous Fens, Verrant Morass
related_quests: Angof the Gravesinger: Stop Angof the Gravesinger's necromantic plan to conquer Glenumbra.
Champion of the Guardians: Help repair the wyrd sister's link to the guardians.
Clarity: Cure Ja-Reet of his mysterious silence.
Deep Disturbance: Discover why the swamp is attacking an Argonian settlement.
The Dream of the Hist: Defeat the alchemist and recover the Mnemic Egg.
The Fangs of Sithis: Find the Fangs of Sithis in the Sunscale Ruins.
Force of Nature: Help three nereid sisters reclaim an abandoned Imperial fort.
Heart of Evil: Drive the hagraven and her Dark Witnesses out of Mournoth.
The Last Spriggan: Try to prevent a spriggan from becoming a lurcher.
Lurcher Demonstration: Show a Northern Elsweyr Defense Force recruit how to combat lurchers.
Pledge: Arx Corinium: Prove you are truly Undaunted by clearing Arx Corinium.
Pledge: City of Ash I: Prove you are truly Undaunted by clearing the City of Ash I.
Purifying the Wyrd Tree: Destroy the corruption of the Beldama Wyrd Tree.
Razor's Edge: Drive back the Daedra from a burning Bosmeri city.
Reclaiming the Elements: Help the wyrd sisters reclaim the Beldama Wyrd.
Restore the Silvenar: Defeat the Hound and observe the Silvenar's marriage to the Green Lady.
Seeking the Guardians: Discover what has become of the elemental guardians.
Smoke on the Horizon: Help defend Boulderfall Pass.
A Tale Forever Told: Ensure the spinners' tale of the Silvenar and the Green Lady is not changed.
summary: Lurchers are wooden golems of multiple origins. Lurchers usually have a green aura, but other varieties include red and blue auras.
